text:
Aisha Patel: Quick recap from Telos Health call — they surfaced three product asks that could affect their renewal if not addressed quickly.

Aisha Patel: 1) Per-route cost breakdown across our multi-model pipeline (they need to show CFO at renewal).
Aisha Patel: 2) Self-serve onboarding checklist + sample prompts/templates for clinical use-cases.
Aisha Patel: 3) Output provenance/explainability metadata (audit logs + token-level redaction guidance).

Tom Baker: Thanks — can we capture each as a feature request with customer impact, frequency, and workaround? I’ll slot into next triage.

Priya Nair: Renewal risk flag — Telos at 73% NPS and mentioned cost transparency heavily. We need immediate mitigation options to reduce churn risk.

Diego Ruiz: From runtime side, per-route cost is mostly doable via current tracing + cost attribution, but multi-model pipelines need sampling to avoid perf overhead. Need actual request volume + example traces.

Marta Chen: I'll paste a short capture template — use this when filing tickets so PMs/Eng can triage quickly:

Marta Chen: ```
Summary: short one-liner
Customer: Telos Health
Impact: (user-facing metric / business ask)
Frequency: (how often observed)
Workaround: (if any)
Ask: (what customer wants)
Priority: (P0/P1/etc)
Example: (copy/paste customer quote)
Contact: (CS owner + customer contact)
``` 

Aisha Patel: Copying template into the notes. Telos provided sample CSV of request traces and two call recordings — I’ll attach to the ticket.

CS Bot: new_nps_response { "customer": "Telos Health", "score": 73, "timestamp": "1767012300" }

Tom Baker: Good. Next steps: Aisha to open three tickets using Marta's template by EOD, tag eng-ml and eng-runtime. I'll review priority and schedule triage on Monday.

Diego Ruiz: I'll prep a short feasibility note for per-route cost (est. 2-3 sprints for full stats pipeline, short-term: sampled cost dashboard in 1 sprint).

Priya Nair: Also prepare a renewal touchpoint script — offer a 30-day trial of dedicated capacity + onboarding runbook to show immediate value.

Marta Chen: I'll create the tickets in Product Intake and add the "renewal-risk" label. +1 on the demo for cost transparency.

Aisha Patel: Ack — creating tickets now and will ping when done. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
